scene: International adult classmates at a friendly Halloween party, handmade black cat ears, pumpkin lanterns and wrapped sweets; cozy, no horror.

lines.zh: 万圣节那天，同学请我去聚会。
lines.pinyin: Wàn shèng Jié nà tiān, tóng xué qǐng wǒ qù jù huì.
lines.en: On Halloween, a classmate invites me to a party.

lines.zh: 我穿了黑衣服，还戴了猫耳朵。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ chuān le hēi yī fu, hái dài le māo ěr duo.
lines.en: I wear black clothes and cat ears.

lines.zh: 门口有一个可爱的南瓜灯。
lines.pinyin: Mén kǒu yǒu yí ge kě ài de nán guā dēng.
lines.en: There is a cute pumpkin lantern by the door.

lines.zh: 朋友笑着问我，你是小猫吗？
lines.pinyin: Péng you xiào zhe wèn wǒ, nǐ shì xiǎo māo ma?
lines.en: My friend smiles and asks if I am a little cat.

lines.zh: 我说，对，我今天是一只黑猫。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shuō, duì, wǒ jīn tiān shì yì zhī hēi māo.
lines.en: I say yes, today I am a black cat.

lines.zh: 我们一边聊天，一边吃糖。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men yì biān liáo tiān, yì biān chī táng.
lines.en: We chat and eat sweets.

lines.zh: 我学会了几个新的中文词。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xué huì le jǐ ge xīn de Zhōng wén cí.
lines.en: I learn a few new Chinese words.

lines.zh: 回家以前，我们一起拍了照片。
lines.pinyin: Huí jiā yǐ qián, wǒ men yì qǐ pāi le zhào piàn.
lines.en: Before going home, we take a photo together.

scene: Two international adult friends walking in a park of vivid red autumn leaves, resting on a bench, showing family photos by phone.

lines.zh: 秋天到了，公园里的叶子红了。
lines.pinyin: Qiū tiān dào le, gōng yuán lǐ de yè zi hóng le.
lines.en: Autumn is here, and the leaves in the park have turned red.

lines.zh: 星期六，我和朋友一起去看红叶。
lines.pinyin: Xīng qī liù, wǒ hé péng you yì qǐ qù kàn hóng yè.
lines.en: On Saturday, my friend and I go to see the red leaves.

lines.zh: 路上有红色的叶子，也有黄色的。
lines.pinyin: Lù shang yǒu hóng sè de yè zi, yě yǒu huáng sè de.
lines.en: There are red and yellow leaves on the path.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢走，听树上的鸟叫。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men màn màn zǒu, tīng shù shang de niǎo jiào.
lines.en: We walk slowly and listen to birds in the trees.

lines.zh: 我想拍照，朋友帮我拿着包。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng pāi zhào, péng you bāng wǒ ná zhe bāo.
lines.en: I want to take photos, so my friend holds my bag.

lines.zh: 走累了，我们坐下喝一点水。
lines.pinyin: Zǒu lèi le, wǒ men zuò xià hē yì diǎn shuǐ.
lines.en: When we get tired, we sit down and drink some water.

lines.zh: 我给家人发了一张红叶的照片。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gěi jiā rén fā le yì zhāng hóng yè de zhào piàn.
lines.en: I send my family a photo of the red leaves.

lines.zh: 妈妈说，这里的秋天真漂亮。
lines.pinyin: Mā ma shuō, zhè lǐ de qiū tiān zhēn piào liang.
lines.en: My mother says autumn here is beautiful.

scene: Adult international friends on a sunny beach building a small sandcastle above the waterline, playing a ball game and watching sunset.

lines.zh: 周末，我和朋友坐车去海边。
lines.pinyin: Zhōu mò, wǒ hé péng you zuò chē qù hǎi biān.
lines.en: At the weekend, my friend and I take a ride to the seaside.

lines.zh: 我们带了水、帽子和一个小球。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men dài le shuǐ, mào zi hé yí ge xiǎo qiú.
lines.en: We bring water, hats and a small ball.

lines.zh: 海水很蓝，沙子暖暖的。
lines.pinyin: Hǎi shuǐ hěn lán, shā zi nuǎn nuǎn de.
lines.en: The sea is blue, and the sand is warm.

lines.zh: 我说，我们做一个小城堡吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shuō, wǒ men zuò yí ge xiǎo chéng bǎo ba.
lines.en: I suggest that we build a little castle.

lines.zh: 朋友找来小桶，我把沙子放进去。
lines.pinyin: Péng you zhǎo lái xiǎo tǒng, wǒ bǎ shā zi fàng jìn qù.
lines.en: My friend finds a bucket, and I put sand in it.

lines.zh: 做好以后，我们在旁边玩球。
lines.pinyin: Zuò hǎo yǐ hòu, wǒ men zài páng biān wán qiú.
lines.en: After finishing, we play ball nearby.

lines.zh: 太阳快下山了，海面变成金色。
lines.pinyin: Tài yáng kuài xià shān le, hǎi miàn biàn chéng jīn sè.
lines.en: As the sun sets, the sea turns golden.

lines.zh: 回家时，我们把垃圾都带走了。
lines.pinyin: Huí jiā shí, wǒ men bǎ lā jī dōu dài zǒu le.
lines.en: When we leave, we take all our rubbish with us.

scene: An international adult student and a friendly street vendor, roasting sweet potatoes on a cool autumn day, sharing a split sweet potato with a classmate.

lines.zh: 下课以后，我走路回家。
lines.pinyin: Xià kè yǐ hòu, wǒ zǒu lù huí jiā.
lines.en: After class, I walk home.

lines.zh: 今天有一点冷，我把手放进口袋。
lines.pinyin: Jīn tiān yǒu yì diǎn lěng, wǒ bǎ shǒu fàng jìn kǒu dài.
lines.en: It is a little cold, so I put my hands in my pockets.

lines.zh: 路边有人在卖烤红薯。
lines.pinyin: Lù biān yǒu rén zài mài kǎo hóng shǔ.
lines.en: Someone is selling roasted sweet potatoes by the road.

lines.zh: 我闻到香味，就停了下来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ wén dào xiāng wèi, jiù tíng le xià lái.
lines.en: I smell the lovely aroma and stop.

lines.zh: 我问老板，这个多少钱？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ wèn lǎo bǎn, zhè ge duō shao qián?
lines.en: I ask the vendor how much this one costs.

lines.zh: 买好以后，我先等它凉一点。
lines.pinyin: Mǎi hǎo yǐ hòu, wǒ xiān děng tā liáng yì diǎn.
lines.en: After buying it, I wait for it to cool a little.

lines.zh: 同学来了，我和她分着吃。
lines.pinyin: Tóng xué lái le, wǒ hé tā fēn zhe chī.
lines.en: A classmate arrives, and I share it with her.

lines.zh: 红薯很甜，吃完心里暖暖的。
lines.pinyin: Hóng shǔ hěn tián, chī wán xīn lǐ nuǎn nuǎn de.
lines.en: The sweet potato is sweet, and I feel warm after eating it.

scene: International adult student browsing an outdoor secondhand book stall, friendly bookseller shows a picture book, sitting in a cafe reading with friend.

lines.zh: 周末，朋友带我去逛旧书市集。
lines.pinyin: Zhōu mò, péng you dài wǒ qù guàng jiù shū shì jí.
lines.en: At the weekend, a friend takes me to a secondhand book market.

lines.zh: 桌上放着各种各样的书。
lines.pinyin: Zhuō shang fàng zhe gè zhǒng gè yàng de shū.
lines.en: There are all kinds of books on the tables.

lines.zh: 我想找一本容易读的中文书。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yì běn róng yì dú de Zhōng wén shū.
lines.en: I want to find an easy Chinese book.

lines.zh: 老板听了，拿给我一本故事书。
lines.pinyin: Lǎo bǎn tīng le, ná gěi wǒ yì běn gù shi shū.
lines.en: The bookseller hears me and hands me a storybook.

lines.zh: 里面有很多图，句子也不长。
lines.pinyin: Lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō tú, jù zi yě bù cháng.
lines.en: It has many pictures and short sentences.

lines.zh: 我试着读了一页，觉得很有意思。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shì zhe dú le yí yè, jué de hěn yǒu yì si.
lines.en: I try reading a page and find it interesting.

lines.zh: 买好书以后，我们找了家咖啡店。
lines.pinyin: Mǎi hǎo shū yǐ hòu, wǒ men zhǎo le jiā kā fēi diàn.
lines.en: After buying the book, we find a cafe.

lines.zh: 我想每天读一点，慢慢把它读完。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng měi tiān dú yì diǎn, màn màn bǎ tā dú wán.
lines.en: I want to read a little each day and gradually finish it.

scene: International adult student realizes one glove is missing, retraces steps to classroom, teacher points to glove under desk, relieved smile.

lines.zh: 放学以后，我准备坐车回家。
lines.pinyin: Fàng xué yǐ hòu, wǒ zhǔn bèi zuò chē huí jiā.
lines.en: After school, I get ready to take a ride home.

lines.zh: 我打开包，发现少了一只手套。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ kāi bāo, fā xiàn shǎo le yì zhī shǒu tào.
lines.en: I open my bag and find that one glove is missing.

lines.zh: 另一只还在包里。
lines.pinyin: Lìng yì zhī hái zài bāo lǐ.
lines.en: The other glove is still in my bag.

lines.zh: 我想了想，又走回教室。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng le xiǎng, yòu zǒu huí jiào shì.
lines.en: I think for a moment and walk back to the classroom.

lines.zh: 老师问我，你在找什么？
lines.pinyin: Lǎo shī wèn wǒ, nǐ zài zhǎo shén me?
lines.en: The teacher asks what I am looking for.

lines.zh: 我说，一只蓝色的手套。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shuō, yì zhī lán sè de shǒu tào.
lines.en: I say that I am looking for a blue glove.

lines.zh: 她指着桌子下面说，在这里。
lines.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe zhuō zi xià miàn shuō, zài zhè lǐ.
lines.en: She points under the desk and says it is here.

lines.zh: 我谢谢老师，把两只手套都戴上。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiè xie lǎo shī, bǎ liǎng zhī shǒu tào dōu dài shang.
lines.en: I thank the teacher and put on both gloves.

scene: Two international adult friends in a quiet museum looking at an old teapot, discussing a display label without readable art text, friendly guide explaining.

lines.zh: 星期天，我和朋友去博物馆。
lines.pinyin: Xīng qī tiān, wǒ hé péng you qù bó wù guǎn.
lines.en: On Sunday, my friend and I go to a museum.

lines.zh: 一个旧茶壶引起了我的兴趣。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge jiù chá hú yǐn qǐ le wǒ de xìng qù.
lines.en: An old teapot catches my interest.

lines.zh: 旁边的牌子上有一段中文介绍。
lines.pinyin: Páng biān de pái zi shang yǒu yí duàn Zhōng wén jiè shào.
lines.en: The label beside it has an introduction in Chinese.

lines.zh: 我先自己读，再问朋友。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiān zì jǐ dú, zài wèn péng you.
lines.en: I read it myself first, then ask my friend.

lines.zh: 有几个字不认识，不过我能猜到一点。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu jǐ ge zì bú rèn shi, bú guò wǒ néng cāi dào yì diǎn.
lines.en: I do not know some characters, but I can guess a little.

lines.zh: 工作人员听见了，慢慢给我们解释。
lines.pinyin: Gōng zuò rén yuán tīng jiàn le, màn màn gěi wǒ men jiě shì.
lines.en: A staff member hears us and explains slowly.

lines.zh: 原来，这把茶壶以前是用来泡茶的。
lines.pinyin: Yuán lái, zhè bǎ chá hú yǐ qián shì yòng lái pào chá de.
lines.en: It turns out that this teapot was once used to make tea.

lines.zh: 看完展览，我记住了几个新词。
lines.pinyin: Kàn wán zhǎn lǎn, wǒ jì zhù le jǐ ge xīn cí.
lines.en: After the exhibition, I remember a few new words.

scene: Small welcoming circle of international adult students and Chinese volunteers, nervous newcomer becomes comfortable speaking, exchanging contact details at end.

lines.zh: 朋友告诉我，学校每周有中文角。
lines.pinyin: Péng you gào su wǒ, xué xiào měi zhōu yǒu Zhōng wén jiǎo.
lines.en: A friend tells me the school has a weekly Chinese language corner.

lines.zh: 我想去练习，可是有一点紧张。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù liàn xí, kě shì yǒu yì diǎn jǐn zhāng.
lines.en: I want to practise, but I feel a little nervous.

lines.zh: 到了那里，大家请我坐在旁边。
lines.pinyin: Dào le nà lǐ, dà jiā qǐng wǒ zuò zài páng biān.
lines.en: When I arrive, everyone invites me to sit beside them.

lines.zh: 今天的话题是自己喜欢的食物。
lines.pinyin: Jīn tiān de huà tí shì zì jǐ xǐ huan de shí wù.
lines.en: Today we talk about our favourite foods.

lines.zh: 我说了家乡的一道菜，还画了一张图。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shuō le jiā xiāng de yí dào cài, hái huà le yì zhāng tú.
lines.en: I describe a dish from my hometown and draw a picture.

lines.zh: 有人没听懂，我就换个简单的说法。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu rén méi tīng dǒng, wǒ jiù huàn ge jiǎn dān de shuō fǎ.
lines.en: When someone does not understand, I try simpler words.

lines.zh: 大家认真听，我慢慢不紧张了。
lines.pinyin: Dà jiā rèn zhēn tīng, wǒ màn màn bù jǐn zhāng le.
lines.en: Everyone listens carefully, and I slowly feel less nervous.

lines.zh: 结束时，我已经想下周再来了。
lines.pinyin: Jié shù shí, wǒ yǐ jīng xiǎng xià zhōu zài lái le.
lines.en: By the end, I already want to come back next week.

scene: International adult learner making dumplings with friends in a home kitchen, learning folding from a friend, everyone eats the cooked dumplings at a table.

lines.zh: 今天，朋友请我去她家包饺子。
lines.pinyin: Jīn tiān, péng you qǐng wǒ qù tā jiā bāo jiǎo zi.
lines.en: Today, a friend invites me to make dumplings at her home.

lines.zh: 我们先洗手，再把桌子擦干净。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men xiān xǐ shǒu, zài bǎ zhuō zi cā gān jìng.
lines.en: We wash our hands and wipe the table clean.

lines.zh: 桌上有饺子皮，还有肉和菜。
lines.pinyin: Zhuō shang yǒu jiǎo zi pí, hái yǒu ròu hé cài.
lines.en: There are dumpling wrappers, meat and vegetables on the table.

lines.zh: 她教我少放一点，再把边合上。
lines.pinyin: Tā jiāo wǒ shǎo fàng yì diǎn, zài bǎ biān hé shang.
lines.en: She teaches me to use a little filling and close the edges.

lines.zh: 我包的第一个饺子有一点大。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bāo de dì yī ge jiǎo zi yǒu yì diǎn dà.
lines.en: The first dumpling I make is a little big.

lines.zh: 朋友说，没关系，再试一次。
lines.pinyin: Péng you shuō, méi guān xi, zài shì yí cì.
lines.en: My friend says it is fine and tells me to try again.

lines.zh: 饺子煮好了，我们一起坐下吃。
lines.pinyin: Jiǎo zi zhǔ hǎo le, wǒ men yì qǐ zuò xià chī.
lines.en: When the dumplings are cooked, we sit down to eat.

lines.zh: 自己做的饺子，吃起来特别香。
lines.pinyin: Zì jǐ zuò de jiǎo zi, chī qǐ lái tè bié xiāng.
lines.en: The dumplings we made ourselves taste especially good.

scene: Adult international learner in a small postcard shop choosing a city-night postcard and a cat postcard, writing messages at a cafe table.

lines.zh: 旅行快结束了，我想买几张明信片。
lines.pinyin: Lǚ xíng kuài jié shù le, wǒ xiǎng mǎi jǐ zhāng míng xìn piàn.
lines.en: My trip is nearly over, and I want to buy some postcards.

lines.zh: 小店里有很多不同的图案。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎo diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō bù tóng de tú àn.
lines.en: The little shop has many different designs.

lines.zh: 我给姐姐挑了一张城市的夜景。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gěi jiě jie tiāo le yì zhāng chéng shì de yè jǐng.
lines.en: I choose a city night view for my older sister.

lines.zh: 给朋友的那张，上面有一只猫。
lines.pinyin: Gěi péng you de nà zhāng, shang miàn yǒu yì zhī māo.
lines.en: The one for my friend has a cat on it.

lines.zh: 老板问我，要不要信封？
lines.pinyin: Lǎo bǎn wèn wǒ, yào bu yào xìn fēng?
lines.en: The shopkeeper asks if I would like envelopes.

lines.zh: 我说，不用了，谢谢。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shuō, bú yòng le, xiè xie.
lines.en: I say no, thank you.

lines.zh: 下午，我坐下来，给每个人写几句话。
lines.pinyin: Xià wǔ, wǒ zuò xià lái, gěi měi ge rén xiě jǐ jù huà.
lines.en: In the afternoon, I sit down and write a few words to each person.

lines.zh: 我希望他们收到以后会笑。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xī wàng tā men shōu dào yǐ hòu huì xiào.
lines.en: I hope they will smile when they receive them.
